content.title: Server Rules
content.text:
• No cheating or hacking.
• No meshing or exploiting.
• Max tribe size: 6.
• No tribe alliances.
• Respect all players and staff.
• Racism, hate speech and harassment are not allowed.
• Use common sense.

Breaking the rules may result in a permanent ban.
